verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible top-to-bottom order (eyebrow, headline, date card, headphones, copy and CTA), but the headphones' grey circle has come loose and sits behind the RSVP button as a stray shape. The date card is shrunk so that 'FRI, 7:30 PM' is barely readable, and the body copy is jammed against the CTA at the bottom. B is worse: the date card is a tiny chip where 'NOV' and the time can't be read, and the 'LISTENING SESSION' eyebrow has dropped below the headphones, which breaks the reading order. The loose circle also collides with the body copy in the bottom-right corner, and the small copy and CTA are crammed into the bottom while a large dead area opens up above.
